de.name: Ntima Eco Village
de.text: Das Ntima Eco Village in Linzolo ist eine umweltfreundliche Anlage, die nachhaltigen ländlichen Tourismus mit traditionellen Baustilen verbindet.

hu.name: Ntima Eco Village
hu.text: A linzolói Ntima Eco Village egy környezetbarát létesítmény, amely a fenntartható vidéki turizmust hagyományos építészeti stílusokkal ötvözi.

ro.name: Ntima Eco Village
ro.text: Ntima Eco Village din Linzolo este un complex ecologic care combină turismul rural durabil cu stilurile tradiționale de construcție.

en.name: Ntima Eco Village
en.text: The Ntima Eco Village in Linzolo is an eco-friendly facility that combines sustainable rural tourism with traditional building styles.
